names: Kyoto State Guest House Main Gate
mapIdentity.scope: The documented ceremonial gate uses the mapped west entrance roof outline and neighboring wall turns. Dimensions above grade are estimated from the verified entrance photograph.

note: Abasaa’s exact photograph establishes the single gently curved dark-gray tiled roof, unpainted dark main posts and doors, narrow open upper lattice, exposed off-white rafter ends, ochre plaster wings and pale stone apron.
